neighbours.label: The compared item after 'compared to' ('compared to 9 pounds for', 'compared to the small baskets used'), peaking at the end of that item; the same subjects with no comparison stay quiet.
fire: Trucks weighed 8 tons, compared to 5 tons for a typical van.
The kilns are huge compared to the small pots used for glazing.
Cats sleep 14 hours, compared to 9 hours for a typical dog.
The towers are tall compared to the old sheds used for storage.
It costs 50 dollars, compared to 30 dollars for the basic model.
The rooms are spacious compared to the tiny cabins used for guests.
Men earn 20 dollars, compared to 18 dollars for women in this sector.
The engine is quiet compared to the noisy motors used on boats.
quiet: Trucks weighed 8 tons and were hard to steer.
The kilns are in the yard behind the pottery shop.
Cats sleep on the sofa all afternoon.
The towers are near the old sheds by the canal.
It costs 50 dollars at the store near my house.
The rooms are on the second floor of the hotel.
Men were working on the road in this sector.
The engine is in the back of the boat.

notes: Probes: 0.53-0.55 with 'compared to'; other contrast frames ('while', 'contrasta con') read 0.13-0.17. Table cells and ' day' in the top examples are not covered.
